name: Reaper release-failed diagnosis (investigation loop)
goal: Prove whether the reaper's ~47 startup 'release failed identity does not match' WARNINGs are H1 (commander runs a pre-7388ad7 workspace-manager, a stale deploy of an already-shipped fix) or H2b (current code, worktrees present on a foreign branch, correct preserve behavior), using worktree presence/branch state as the primary time-robust discriminator, and write a findings note with evidence and recommended remediation. Strictly read-only; no code, no mutation, no restart, no redeploy.

tasks.name: Diagnose the reaper owned-gone failures and write the findings note
tasks.description: Read-only diagnosis. PRIMARY discriminator = worktree presence/branch state (monotonic; only pre-7388ad7 throws the identity message on a gone worktree), guarded by exact-message discipline (only validateManagedIdentity's :179 string) and the code's present-conjunction (existsSync AND in git worktree list). Dump the leaked assignment rows from the workspace-manager DB (env-first, the daemon's env; sqlite3 -readonly); classify each guid gone vs present-on-foreign-branch; match each warned guid to its exact exception text from the commander log; corroborate with the version-matched bundle's reapLeakedAssignment marker and temporal signals; then write docs/plans/2026-08-21-reaper-owned-gone-findings.md declaring H1/H2b/mixed with evidence and remediation. No tests required: read-only diagnosis whose deliverable is the findings note; every value is measured live and pasted, not asserted.

steps.description: Resolve the workspace-manager DB path env-first (the DAEMON's env, main.py:238-242) and dump the leaked rows. Locate the commander PID + start time (ps -eo pid,lstart,command), read the daemon env for WORKSPACE_MANAGER_DB_PATH (ps -p <PID> -wwwE, darwin BSD) and this shell's (printenv WORKSPACE_MANAGER_DB_PATH); resolved path = daemon env if set else ~/.claude/ironclaude-workspaces.db. Record BOTH outcomes. Then sqlite3 -readonly SELECT on the resolved path.
steps.expected: Commander PID + start time (lstart). Followed by: printenv WORKSPACE_MANAGER_DB_PATH and ps -p <PID> -wwwE to determine the override; record whether set and to what. Discovery step.

steps.description: Dump the leaked assignment rows read-only from the resolved DB path (default shown; substitute the env override if set). No 2>/dev/null (a missing DB must be visible).
steps.command: sqlite3 -readonly /Users/roberthyatt/.claude/ironclaude-workspaces.db "SELECT workspace_guid, repository_identity, lifecycle_status, recovery_ref, worktree_path, owner_session_id FROM assignments WHERE lifecycle_status != 'cleaned' ORDER BY repository_identity, lifecycle_status;"
steps.expected: One row per still-leaked assignment showing lifecycle_status, recovery_ref presence, worktree_path. Superset of the reaper candidate set (captures the ~47).

steps.description: PRIMARY discriminator: classify every leaked row gone vs present-on-foreign-branch by the code's conjunction. present = existsSync(worktree_path) AND path in git worktree list (workspace-service.ts:752-753); foreign = present AND porcelain branch != refs/heads/ironclaude/<workspace_guid> (detached/null = foreign, :178). Derive the owning repo primary checkout from a worktree_path (substring before /.ironclaude/worktrees/). Run ls of the worktrees dir AND git worktree list --porcelain (per owning repo).
steps.expected: Per-guid classification: GONE (dir absent OR not git-listed) vs PRESENT-ON-FOREIGN-BRANCH (both hold, branch != managed ironclaude/<guid>). Also run: ls -la <owning-repo-primary-checkout>/.ironclaude/worktrees. GONE -> H1 evidence; present-foreign -> H2b evidence; MIXED is valid. Enumerate the repo path from Step 2's worktree_path values.

steps.description: Exact-message discipline: match each warned guid to its precise exception text from the commander log. Only validateManagedIdentity's exact :179 string enters the gone->H1 inference; post-7388ad7 throws OTHER messages on gone worktrees via the same 'release failed' wrapper.
steps.expected: Per warned workspace=<guid>, the exact trailing exception text. Only 'Managed worktree Git identity does not match durable assignment; reconciliation must preserve it' warnings count as H1 evidence in Step 5; a different message is NOT H1. If the log path differs, record the actual path (no 2>/dev/null).

steps.description: CORROBORATION: identify the bundle the commander resolves by version-match (_select_discovered_root, workspace_client.py:73-88 — the cache root whose plugin.json base_version == commander version, cli_exists, manifest_valid), grep it for the post-7388ad7 marker reapLeakedAssignment, and capture temporal signals. Enumerate claude + codex cache roots (ls), read each manifest (cat <root>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json or .codex-plugin), then grep -c and stat the matched cli.js, and stat the worktrees dir.
steps.expected: The matched bundle root; its reapLeakedAssignment count (0=pre, >0=post-7388ad7); cli.js mtime vs commander lstart (restarted since deploy?); worktrees-dir mtime (earlier than lstart => no external deletion since startup). Also: ls the codex cache; cat each manifest; grep -c reapLeakedAssignment <matched cli.js>; stat -f '%Sm %N' <matched cli.js> and <worktrees dir>. Corroborates the running/next-sweep code; does not alone prove what ran at warning time.

steps.description: Write docs/plans/2026-08-21-reaper-owned-gone-findings.md with ACTUAL output from prior steps as evidence: (a) per-guid gone/present-foreign classification + exact-message match; (b) leaked rows' lifecycle_status/recovery_ref summary; (c) corroboration (resolved bundle pre/post-7388ad7 + temporal signals); (d) verdict per guid: H1 (gone + :179 message -> pre-7388ad7 ran; remediation = update the claude-cache workspace-manager to post-7388ad7 and restart the commander, then the gone-tolerant reaper reaps the rows, anchoring any branch tip first), H2b (present-on-foreign-branch -> guard correct; scoped follow-up loop), or MIXED; (e) any guid/question unanswered and why.
steps.expected: The findings note exists and answers (a)-(d) with pasted evidence.
The findings note is staged (professional mode blocks commit).
